messages.subject: rapache through opencpu on Ubuntu 14.04  =>  ":error ...  rApache Notice!"
parts:
Hi!

I am getting error.log messages like these (below) when requesting R calculations, actually one or two lines per R request through opencpu. It is the same whether making the request through a browser or through curl. The calculations and responses actually work but I am wondering what the errors refer to.


[Thu Feb 18 16:00:20.051746 2016] [:error] [pid 9357] [client my_remote_nginx_load_balancer_server_url:57167] rApache Notice!



I have noticed that if I look into the system processes then pid's refer to so-called "defunct" processses. For example:

$ ps aux 
www-data  9357  4.0  0.0      0     0 ?        Z    16:00   0:00 [apache2] <defunct>



Thank you!


Br,

Sinan
